Introducing our Double Layered Longsleeve T-Shirt in AcidGrey color with Pink Sleeves. 
This T-Shirt combines a unique streetwear look with ultimate comfort. 
The shirt is cut for a loose fit and is made from 330 grams of 100% cotton jersey – heavy, durable and perfect for everyday use.
The sewn-in sleeves in contrasting pink create a layered effect without having to wear extra layers. 
The acid wash on the black shirt gives it a vintage look, while the graphics and logos add a modern edge.

Details:
• Loose fit for a relaxed look
• 330 g/m² 100% cotton jersey
• Set-in double-layered sleeves in pink
• Acid wash for a unique vintage finish

We recommend taking the same size as you normally wear,
our sizing is based on an average Dutch person.
This item is made for a loose fit.
This item is intended to fit loose on the torso and wide on the arms.

Are you unsure about the size?
Try the size suggestion from JORCUSTOM, where you can fill in your height and weight for a size advice.
You can also contact us via whatsapp and we will help you select the right size.
Please use the whatsapp-icon in the header to app to us directly.
